notes.title: Christmas update
notes.notes:
Another year is approaching and festivities are all around us. On behalf of our entire creative team, we want to wish you and all those around you: a [b]Merry Christmas[/b] and a [b]Happy New Year![/b] That we wish you may spend a lot of precious time with those you love and cherish in one of the coziest times of the year. 

To help you get even more in a festive mood, we have added Christmas decorations to the game and added a small quest where you can earn yourself a unique and rare gift: a potion to redistribute your skill points. So be sure to use it wisely! 

We're also happy to announce the release of even more related content: [b]soundtracks[/b] and a [b]digital artbook[/b], where we've collected a variety of sketches, photos and more! All which are used in the game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247910/Force_of_Nature_2__Collectors_Pack/
We certainly hope you enjoy this exciting new content to the fullest! 

[i]Happy Holidays everyone![/i]

notes.title: Halloween Update for Force of Nature 2: Ghost Keeper
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40531452/705fc13b15755c677c31ed8f0ccab322859168d8.jpg[/img]

Join us for the ultimate Halloween in-game event on October 25, 2022 for Steam Scream Fest with plenty of spirits, spooky decor, sweet treats, and more! 

[b]New Quest[/b]
Partake in a special holiday quest featuring ghosts! You must go through a number of ghosts to “kill” them and, when you’ve killed a certain amount, you will receive an exclusive pumpkin helmet as a spooky reward! 

[b]New Seasonal Decor[/b]
Looking to add some ghoulish glamour to your home? We have some spooktacular Halloween decorations you can use that include:
[list]
[*] A ghostly scarecrow
[*] Bush that looks like a witch
[*] Halloween style environmental objects
[/list]

[b]New Interactive Items[/b]
We’ve also included a few gourd-themed interactive items such as:
[list]
[*] Pumpkins for players to throw
[*] Pumpkin juice
[*] Pumpkin pie
[/list]

We hope that this in-game event, decorations, and interactive items help you to ring in Halloween!

notes.title: Update 1.0.17
notes.notes:
[list][*]Hero can now automatically retaliate against enemy attacks[/list]If you stand still and you're under attack, the hero will start hitting back. You can disable this options in the settings.

Also:[list][*]Reduced the required stamina points for [b]Berserk[/b], [b]Critical strike[/b], [b]Dash[/b], [b]Sprint[/b] and [b]Block[/b]
[*]Amount of enemies on the Tropical Island has been reduced by 20%
[*]Experience gained for killing enemies of the Tropical Island has been increased by 20% ([i]to compensate the decreased amount of enemies[/i])
[*]Increased amount of scrap dropped from killing turtles and metal knights
[*]The damage received from the cannons of the pirate boss fight has been decreased from 40 to 25 per hit[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.16
notes.notes:
Added more options for you to configure the difficulty of the game to your liking.

There are 3 settings in total:[list][*][b]Simplified combat[/b] - enemies have less health and their attacks deal less damage
[*][b]Faster crafting[/b] - duration of all recipes is significantly reduced
[*][b]Increased inventory[/b] - inventory size increased by 8 additional slots[/list]They can be set individually.

You can also change these settings for existing save games in three simple steps: click [b]"CONTINUE"[/b] in the main menu, select a game and in the lower left corner click [b]"Change game mode"[/b].

Now each player can more accurately adjust the difficulty of the game for themselves!

notes.title: Update 1.0.13
notes.notes:
[list][*]Reduced size of the seedbed window
[*]Fertilizers moved from the additional window into the main seedbed window
[*]Added hotkey for the "Plant" button (by default it is P)[/list]
Now it will be much easier to plant crops in the seedbeds - just click on the seedbed (right mouse button if moving by mouse, left mouse button if moving by keys), and press P

[list][*]Added button to call tamed animal - the animal will come close to you[/list]
Now it will be much easier to drive animals into pens

[list][*]Attack speed for all melee weapons (Axes, Picks, Cudgel, Swords, Spears, Maces, Torches) increased by 20%
[*]Usage speed for Jug, Buckets, Hoes and Shovels increased by 10%
[*]Increased amount of health for all bosses by 10% (to compensate for the increased attack speed of the main hero)
[*]Reduced cooldowns for all active skills
